background: Secure Trust Bank is a UK specialist lender listed in London, funded by retail savings and lending on vehicle finance, retail point-of-sale finance, real-estate development and commercial finance.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the bank. Capital is mixed against UK small banks: CET1 of 14.3% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median, while leverage of 10.3% is at the median, and both have risen since 31 Dec 2023, CET1 by 1.6 points and leverage by 0.6 points. Liquidity is on the weak side of a group that runs very high liquidity, with LCR of 209% below the peer median; no NSFR is held. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. An unrated specialist lender with improving but below-peer capital.
